c3_uncertain_resolution.question: Is the PCT/ledger writeback path inert when AEGIS_RLS_ACTIVE=false, given it has no in-orb active gate?
c3_uncertain_resolution.resolution: The writeback path is unreachable when inactive: processor_daemon._init_rls_engine() returns None when not self._rls_active (processor_daemon.py:87-91); op_rls_session then returns {executed:false, 'RLS engine not active'} (processor_daemon.py:287-292); execute_session(..., writeback_enabled=True) at processor_daemon.py:311 is only reached with a non-None engine, i.e. only when rls_active. The orb engine is never even constructed when inactive, so build_and_append_pct / append_ledger never execute.
c3_uncertain_resolution.residual_hardening_recommendation: The PCT/ledger writeback is gated only at the caller (_init_rls_engine), whereas record_relation is double-gated (caller + store-side is_active). Add an in-store active gate on append_ledger for symmetric defense-in-depth. Guarantee currently holds; recommendation is hardening, not a fix for a live hole.
